tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main buttons, links, focus ring, selected items. As text: light 6.4:1 on `surface`, 5.9:1 on `canvas`; dark 8.0:1 and 8.7:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted `primary`. Light darkens, dark lightens; `on-primary` reads 9.6:1 / 9.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info alerts, secondary-button hover. Background only: `ink` (15.3:1 / 11.3:1) or `primary` (5.5:1 / 6.1:1) on it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill: 6.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. White in light, deep teal in dark, so never write `text-white` on a primary button. Added beyond the brief.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Dark is a blue-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, nav bar, menus. One step lighter than `canvas` in dark so cards lift without shadows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers only. Decorative (about 1.25:1 in both themes): never the only edge of something you tap.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, code-box and secondary-button borders: light 3.7:1 on `surface`, 3.4:1 on `canvas`; dark 4.0:1 and 4.3:1.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons (the brief's #E3E6EA in light). Put `muted` text on it: 6.2:1 / 6.3:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on `canvas`, `surface`, `primary-soft` and every `-soft` status fill: 11:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions on `canvas` and `surface`: 7.2–7.8:1 light, 7.9–8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy badge text and icon, success message text. On `success-soft`: 8.3:1 light, 9.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Healthy badge and success message fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock badge text and icon, warning alert text. On `warning-soft`: 7.5:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Low stock badge and warning alert fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Out of stock and Expired badge text, error message text, destructive-button hover fill. On `danger-soft`: 8.2:1 / 8.3:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Out of stock / Expired badge and error message fill.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill; field error text, icon and border. As text on `surface` 6.5:1 in both themes; on `danger-soft` 5.3:1 / 5.9:1.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger-solid` or `danger` fill: 6.5:1 light, 6.9:1 dark. Added beyond the brief.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series in charts (bars, lines). A brighter teal than `primary` because chart marks need chroma to read as colour. Charts only: never text, never buttons.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series. Orange, picked to stay apart from teal for colour-blind readers (validated: worst pair ΔE 11.4 light, 13.0 dark). Not a status colour.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. Charts never show more than three; fold the rest into "Other". Values and labels stay in `ink` / `muted`, never in a series colour.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Landing-page hero headline and the big number in a stat card. One per screen.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Screen title: Welcome back, Check your email, Dashboard.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Card titles, section titles, menu headings.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Everything people read: descriptions, form text, table rows. Never smaller in inputs (iOS zooms below 16px).
styles.sample: Oat Milk: 3 cartons left, reorder at 6.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Hints, secondary lines in a row, footer text.
styles.sample: We sent a code to hello@buzzybeans.com

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Status badges and tiny meta (Sample data). Never for sentences.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels and nav links. Added beyond the brief's scale so labels stay consistent.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; tightest nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to label in buttons; between code boxes.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside alerts and form messages; between a row's two lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side padding on phones; card padding on phones; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from 640px up; gap between cards; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones; page side padding from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between landing sections on phones. Added beyond the brief's list for page rhythm.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between landing sections from 768px. Added beyond the brief's list for page rhythm.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every button and text input (the brief allows 48–52px; 52 keeps thumbs comfortable). Tailwind: `h-control`.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and chart flags. Tailwind: `size-4`.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, fields, alerts, form messages. Tailwind: `size-5`.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Menu toggle, app-nav icons, empty-state tiles. Tailwind: `size-6`.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: icon buttons, Show/Hide, text links, menu toggle. Tailwind: `min-h-tap min-w-tap`.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, code boxes, alerts, form messages, the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, stat cards, the auth card, the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons. Same as `radius-control` today; its own token so per-business theming can round buttons without touching inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and the Sample data tag.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: No shadows in Ledger Clean, in either theme: cards are edged by a 1px `border`. Kept as a token so code can say `shadow-card` and stay correct if that ever changes.
